rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Gates all skill installations behind comprehensive threat detection, scanning GitHub repositories against 60+ threat patterns across categories including prompt injection, reverse shells, credential theft, supply chain attacks, and cryptocurrency mining. Critical threats are permanently blocked while medium/high risk installations require explicit force override. Provides search and AI-powered discovery of skills from the SkillsMP marketplace, cloud sync capabilities, and compatibility across multiple MCP clients including Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Zed, and nanobot.
